title: Synthesis of SGLT2 inhibitor O-glucoside derivatives for enhancing anti-heart failure activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21922-21933
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00235D, Paper
Open Access

Yu Liu, Xiaodong Fang, Meng Sun, Xutong Wang, Kejing Ma, Bing Wang, Qiming Li, Jan Mohammad Omar, Yihui Liu, Heng Liu, Weina Han
By retaining the pharmacophore of phlorizin and introducing a tyramine moiety, 11 O-glucoside compounds were designed and synthesized. D4 showed low toxicity and high SGLT2 inhibition, making it a promising candidate for heart failure treatment.
